def: an award (of arbitration), i.e. (specially) a prize in the public games

occurrences.text: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
